Movie Dialogue Network: Clustering

Local clustering Cᵢ is the fraction of a character’s neighbors who are connected to each other. A value of 1 means all neighbors are linked; 0 means no links among neighbors. Characters with fewer than two neighbors are assigned 0.

Use the controls to compare edge definitions and movies. The Erdős–Rényi benchmark uses C ≈ p, where p is network density and matches the random graph’s mean degree ⟨k⟩. The benchmark is an expected value, not a simulated network or confidence interval.

The graph is a simple, undirected network for measuring clustering: repeated evidence affects edge thickness, not degree or Cᵢ. Chapter co-appearance will create triangles when three characters speak in the same chapter, so interpret that mode as shared chapter participation rather than direct conversation.
